summary: Kandal M Venture Limited, a Cambodia-domiciled leather-goods maker listed on Nasdaq, disclosed via Form 6-K that on October 15, 2026 it received a Nasdaq Listing Qualifications staff deficiency letter for failing to maintain at least 500,000 publicly held shares under Listing Rule 5550(a)(4). Nasdaq set a November 30, 2026 deadline to submit a compliance plan with a completion timeframe; rejection would allow a Nasdaq Hearings Panel appeal. No terms, advisors, or board recommendation were stated. Watch plan acceptance and any reverse-split or capital-raise mechanics, with delisting risk elevated given the thin float.
